title.id: Rilis v1.0.3 — Peluncuran ErTerm dengan React, Vite, shadcn/ui, dan Mesin Terminal Lengkap
title.en: Release v1.0.3 — ErTerm Launch with React, Vite, shadcn/ui, and Full Terminal Core

body.id: ErTerm kini resmi menjadi klien terminal utama dengan antarmuka modern berbasis React 19, Vite, dan shadcn/ui, menanamkan seluruh mesin inti terminal canggih: socket forwarder TCP/SOCKS5, server loncat (bastion), editor SFTP interaktif, pengelompokan folder seret-dan-lepas, serta sinkronisasi registry akun terpadu.
body.en: ErTerm is now officially the primary terminal client featuring a modern React 19, Vite, and shadcn/ui interface, embedding the full advanced terminal engine: TCP/SOCKS5 socket forwarding, bastion jump hosts, interactive SFTP editor, drag-and-drop folder grouping, and unified account registry synchronization.

items.id: Antarmuka Modern React 19 & shadcn/ui: Desain visual presisi dengan palet tema gelap, tipografi mono, dan navigasi modular.
items.en: Modern React 19 & shadcn/ui UI: Pixel-precise visual design with dark theme palette, mono typography, and modular navigation.

items.id: Mesin Inti Terminal Penuh: WebSocket PTY streaming (ConPTY / macOS zsh), klien SSH2, broadcast input multi-tab, dan perekaman sesi log.
items.en: Full Terminal Core Engine: WebSocket PTY streaming (ConPTY / macOS zsh), SSH2 client, multi-tab broadcast input, and session logging.

items.id: Pengelompokan Folder & Drag-and-Drop: Menata server dalam folder kustom dengan ikon, warna, dan interaksi seret-lepas.
items.en: Folder Grouping & Drag-and-Drop: Organize servers into custom folders with icons, colors, and drag-and-drop interactions.

items.id: Penerusan Port & Proksi SOCKS5 Aktif: Listener socket TCP nyata dan SOCKS5 proxy dinamis dengan pemantauan status langsung.
items.en: Active Port Forwarding & SOCKS5 Proxy: Real TCP socket listeners and dynamic SOCKS5 proxy with live status monitoring.

items.id: Server Perantara Bastion (ProxyJump): Menghubungkan sesi terminal dan SFTP ke server privat internal secara aman.
items.en: Bastion Jump Host (ProxyJump): Connect terminal and SFTP sessions to internal private servers securely.

items.id: Manajer SFTP Dua Panel & Editor Berkas: Eksplorasi berkas lokal ⇄ remote dengan editor kode terintegrasi dan simpan instan Ctrl+S.
items.en: Dual-Pane SFTP Manager & File Editor: Explore local ⇄ remote files with an integrated code editor and Ctrl+S instant save.

items.id: Penyimpanan Registry Akun & Sinkronisasi Cloud: Snapshot workspace tersimpan per akun di disk lokal dan tersinkronisasi ke Neon PostgreSQL.
items.en: Account Registry Storage & Cloud Sync: Account-scoped workspace snapshots saved locally and synced to Neon PostgreSQL.
